purpose: Assess the previously identified fixed-target USD20 deployment region under bounded friction, demand and adverse conditions, and report spendable operating-generated resources without changing original cash or full-history returns.
output_exposure_note: The separately reviewed copy adds only competitorAccounts at the final return; original economic fields and behavior are unchanged. Full native competitor states are preserved in this extension at execution.
initial_funding_interpretation: Seed-inclusive available cash under the existing core affordability and expected-benefit gates; same finite USD1000 opening cash and USD200 reserve as before, no replenishment or extra capital. This does not label initial adoption as earned-funded.

adverse_corners.interpretation: Single adverse intervention per corner. Collection-delay variants change timing alone, leaving payment probability unchanged. Failed integration keeps all construction/adoption costs unchanged, is immediately detected, and allows incumbent delivery without forced downtime; planned successful-adoption pause metadata does not claim failed downtime. This is not a prolonged-failure stress. No mixture is selected after outcomes.

funding_views.original_strict_metric: Preserve core earnedAvailableCents=min(cash-unpaid-reserve, collections-allAccruedCosts-reserve), including negative values, unchanged in every original history and summary.
funding_views.historical_allocation: Only the explicitly seed-paid opening historical R&D bill is excluded from operating-generated recovery. It remains charged once in full profit and cash. Unpaid or later R&D is never excluded.
funding_views.prospective_cost_recovery: Shared setup, first adoption, failed integration/construction charges, delivery, upkeep, refunds and all other prospective accrued expenses remain deducted. No seed-supported current operating deficit is called generated surplus.
funding_views.reserve: One liquidity reserve is deducted in the cash bound. It is not deducted again from the generated-cash bound under this disclosed funding convention.
funding_views.earmarks: Only outstanding generated-resource earmarks not yet accrued may be deducted, from BOTH cash and generated-resource bounds. Release an earmark when its bill accrues to avoid double charging. With no actual second-candidate commitment, earmarks are exactly zero. Required counterexample: cash-cap100/generated500/earmark80 gives20, not100.
funding_views.full_cost_recovery_sensitivity: Also report max(0,min(cash-unpaid-reserve,collections-allAccruedCosts)-outstandingUnaccruedGeneratedEarmarks); this keeps historical R&D in the generated-resource recovery requirement.
funding_views.unpriced_incremental_discovery: The actual bounded second-asset search has unknown monetary cost D>=0, outside original core bills. Every reported G is BEFORE_UNPRICED_SECOND_ASSET_DISCOVERY, a funding ceiling. G_after_search<=max(0,G_reported-D); fixed-path profit is reduced by any attributed D. D remains null/unknown, never silently zero, and is never reclassified as seed-paid opening historical R&D.
funding_views.authority: Reporting and provenance views only: no alteration of original prices, decisions, cash, profit, invoices, costs or reserves; no real financial authority.

successor_gate.no_tested_asset_action: HOLD: report resources and missing qualification; do not purchase or finance a hypothetical successor.
successor_gate.qualification: A source-identified actual retained candidate, frozen acceptance before fresh tests, material measured burden/benefit, strong conventional comparator and explicit all-in cost uncertainty must exist before any succession affordability claim. Positive balance alone is insufficient.
successor_gate.core_behavior: The unchanged core retains reserves; this campaign measures funding availability. A tested candidate would require an explicitly reviewed pre-outcome affordability decision rule, not an automatic second purchase or invented revenue.

outcomes: Full-history and prospective enterprise profit, B-minus-A and B-minus-C under each declared condition
First adoption timing, failure, cost, exact asset use and seed-permitted funding
Generated spendable resources by week and at collection drain, original strict metric and full-cost-recovery sensitivity
Net collected cash, receivables, bills, reserves, refunds, rejected jobs and complete competitor accounts
All failed/no-adoption/adverse cases without favorable selection
Affordability and qualification kept separate; no second purchase absent a tested candidate and pre-outcome rule
statistics: Paired common external draws within each fresh seed. All24 independent fresh seeds per condition; normal-approximation95percent conditional Monte Carlo mean intervals, explicitly unadjusted across128 conditions and excluding unidentified parameter uncertainty. No Nash, optimality, global robustness or real-adoption claim.

representative_selection_before_outcomes.figures: All integration and arrival levels for both choice models and cost bases; all ten adverse variants; no substitution of a winning history after outcomes.

stopping_rule: Exactly128 configurations and24 new seeds. No scenario addition, price search, horizon extension or optional rerun after outcomes. Preserve partial failures if the120second CPU/wall limits or research cutoff bind; do not omit failures or present unfinished results as complete.
registered_reproduction: After a completed original archive exists, --replay-registered may reproduce only these identical frozen128 configurations and24 seeds, after verifying source/freeze/archive hashes and requiring exact original paired JSON equality for every world. It bypasses the scientific cutoff only for this registered replication, uses a new output directory, and counts zero new economic scenarios/evidence. It cannot accept different prices, seeds, scenarios or model code.
